loadLibraryW.records: lib_burst_generated.dll module identity and returned HMODULE

getProcAddress.records: matching HMODULE lpProcName, returned pointer, and GameAssembly caller backtrace

evidenceBoundary.scope: Read-only LoadLibraryW/GetProcAddress observation for one exact lib_burst_generated.dll HMODULE and bounded GameAssembly-only caller backtraces.
nonClaims: The trace does not call a resolver export, replace a resolver body, or write game state.
A returned proc pointer is an identity observation only; it does not prove the pointer was called or map it to a Burst generic.
Only GetProcAddress calls whose hModule equals the observed lib_burst_generated.dll HMODULE are recorded.
The caller backtrace is bounded and contains only frames resolved inside GameAssembly.dll; an empty backtrace is not identity proof.
The pinned executable, GameAssembly.dll, and global-metadata.dat hashes describe one client build; drift refuses attach.
evidenceBoundary.stopRule: Stop on attach refusal, protection termination, native hash/module drift, missing kernel32 exports, hook failure, malformed bounded read, or event cap; do not retry through evasion.
